headlines.text: Rewind to 2024, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Dante Martin went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.48. It was the 30th time the AEW International Title had been on the line, a significant milestone for the title. Cassidy fought off a spirited Top Flight challenger to retain the International Title with the Orange Punch, as Darius Martin and Action Andretti checked on a fallen Dante afterward.
Back on this day in 2026, Big Bill stepped back through the curtain after just under 3 months away, appearing on Collision.
On a Wednesday in 2024, back when Queen Aminata made their AEW debut against Mariah May, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.33.
